likely_fatal_step.reason: It simultaneously claims that the coupling is order-preserving and obtained by a cumulative-mass scan, and that the coupling first minimizes direction mismatch over couplings. Those are different feasible sets and can reverse the candidate order; this was attacked first with the executed two-edge counterexample.

consumes: VERBATIM: Read the frozen M1/M2 source likelihood Lsrc_{s,t}, carrier likelihood Lcar_{s,t}, GADEN concentration y_t, timestamp, position, and existing causal run identifier for every candidate s on the realized prefix; output a schema-checked prefix table without source truth.
produces: prefix table P with rows (r,t,y_t,Lsrc_{s,t},Lcar_{s,t}) and baseline candidate/value order
formalized_procedure.note: The stated inputs contain no true-source identity. The source subscript in Lsrc denotes the candidate-conditioned source field, not the sequestered true source.

consumes: VERBATIM: Within each run and current causal prefix, difference adjacent y values and adjacent candidate log source-over-carrier contrasts g_{s,t}; output signed transition sequences plus normalized nonnegative masses a_i and b_{s,i}.
produces: for each run r: observation tokens (i/n_r,u_i,a_i)
for each candidate s and run r: field tokens (i/n_r,v_{s,i},b_{s,i})
formalized_procedure.note: Original reading: a_i=|Delta y_i|/A_r and b_{s,i}=|Delta g_{s,i}|/B_{sr}. A_r=0 or B_{sr}=0 makes the division undefined before the later identity clause. epsilon_machine is named but its floating dtype is not bound.

consumes: VERBATIM: For every candidate, build the ordered observation and field token lists and their direction-mismatch and normalized time-displacement pair costs; output the candidate-specific transport instance.
produces: candidate/run transport nodes and pair costs d_dir in {0,1}, d_time=|i/n_r-j/n_r|
formalized_procedure.note: The token order is chronological within each run.

consumes: VERBATIM: Solve the lexicographic one-dimensional monotone transport by cumulative mass scanning; output O_s and T_s=(Cdir_s,Ctime_s) for every candidate, with explicit zero-mass status flags.
formalized_procedure.note: DUAL READING M: cumulative scanning fixes the unique chronological monotone coupling, then Cdir and Ctime evaluate that coupling and candidate scores are compared lexicographically. DUAL READING L: optimize Cdir over arbitrary couplings first, then Ctime among direction-optimal couplings. The text supports both; executed results differ. The original does not specify how per-run scores are aggregated after runs are computed independently and concatenated.

consumes: VERBATIM: Stable-sort candidates by ascending T_s while preserving the baseline order on exact ties; output the truth-blind candidate permutation.
formalized_procedure.note: This step is deterministic once S4 and run aggregation are fixed; exact ties are fully specified.

consumes: VERBATIM: Stable-sort the current baseline likelihood values and assign them to the candidate permutation from step 5; output the multiset-preserving M3 likelihood vector that is passed directly to the unchanged Bayesian accumulator and then to the unchanged action selector.
formalized_procedure.note: Reading is unambiguous when combined with core_mechanism: sort values descending and assign in pi order. Candidate associations change whenever pi changes and values are nonconstant, while the multiset is exactly preserved. No truth or tuned threshold enters.

consumes: VERBATIM: In the offline gate only, cyclically shift each completed run's candidate-field token values by delta_r=floor(n_r/2) before rebuilding costs, rerun steps 3–6, and output the shifted-pairing negative-control vector; runs without a nonzero shift are marked non-informative rather than silently pooled.
produces: shifted-control T_s, permutation, and M3 vector
formalized_procedure.note: Dual reading of 'token values': shifting direction and mass together is the only reading consistent with rebuilding pair costs; shifting direction alone would detach magnitude from its signed transition. The half-shift can change scores but is not guaranteed to do so.

consumes: VERBATIM: Freeze hashes of the baseline, aligned-transport, and shifted-control vectors for all fixed H02/H03 comparisons, then let the sequestered evaluator reveal source identities and compute the preregistered downstream ordering metric.
formalized_procedure.note: Truth is consumed only after all candidate orders are frozen, so the mechanism itself is truth-blind.

dry_run.instance: One run with n_r=4 edges. Observation deltas are [3,-1,2,-4]. Candidate transitions are A_local=[5,-10,0.3,-1], A_scaled=10^-6*A_local, and B_pooled=[0.3,-0.3,0.3,-0.3]. Baseline order is [B_pooled,A_scaled,A_local] with likelihood values {0.60,0.25,0.15}. A pooled-Pearson ranking is the fair naive. Both S4 readings are executed. A separate two-edge sign-reversal probe attacks the S4 guarantee; zero-mass and periodic-shift probes attack degeneracies and the null claim.

anomalies.anomaly: Step 4's two defensible readings are not equivalent: the two-edge probe returns monotone T=(1.0,0.0) versus unrestricted direction-first T=(0.0,0.5), and the full dry-run candidate orders are opposite.
anomalies.why: This is a feasible-set contradiction, not an empirical magnitude: chronological noncrossing and arbitrary direction-optimal transport admit different couplings. Reading-dependent: the defect is present because both readings are asserted simultaneously.

anomalies.anomaly: The claim that magnitude is retained is too broad: A_local and its 10^-6 scaling receive exactly identical masses and scores despite a 1,000,000x total-variation ratio.
anomalies.why: Independent normalization algebraically cancels every positive candidate-wide scale. Reading-robust: only relative within-run magnitude distribution remains.

anomalies.anomaly: All-identical observations or a flat candidate field produce a zero denominator before the later identity/status clause can act.
anomalies.why: The original ordering of operations defines a_i and b_{s,i} by division first; tokens([0,0]) returned None for both sides. Reading-robust.

anomalies.anomaly: The universal-sounding statement that the half-shift null is not algebraically invariant is false: a nonconstant period-2 direction sequence with equal masses is unchanged by a half shift and has T=T_shift=(0,0).
anomalies.why: A half-run cyclic shift has fixed points (including periodic nonconstant sequences); order sensitivity only means the score can change, not that it must. Reading-robust.

anomalies.anomaly: On the invented full instance, the unrestricted direction-first reading orders candidates exactly like pooled Pearson while the monotone reading changes the evidence order.
anomalies.why: The equality of these two orders depends on the chosen transitions, so it cannot alone block the idea; it demonstrates that the S4 ambiguity changes the claimed depth result. Reading-dependent.

applied_revisions.value: For each causally available observation edge i=(t-1,t) in each existing completed run and the current prefix, let n_r be that run's edge count and form Delta y_i=y_t-y_{t-1}. For candidate s, compute g_{s,t}=log((Lsrc_{s,t}+epsilon_machine)/(Lcar_{s,t}+epsilon_machine)), where epsilon_machine is fixed to the machine epsilon of the frozen likelihood-storage dtype (IEEE-754 float64 by default), the dtype and value are hashed, and it is never swept. Before division, compute A_r=sum_i|Delta y_i| and B_{sr}=sum_i|Delta g_{s,i}|. A run is common-informative only when A_r>0 and B_{sr}>0 for every candidate in that comparison; otherwise exclude that run for every candidate. If no common-informative run remains, M3 is the identity. On each common-informative run form observation tokens (i/n_r,u_i,a_i), with u_i=sign(Delta y_i) and a_i=|Delta y_i|/A_r, and field tokens (i/n_r,v_{s,i},b_{s,i}), with v_{s,i}=sign(Delta g_{s,i}) and b_{s,i}=|Delta g_{s,i}|/B_{sr}. Thus both sides carry unit mass on common support: relative within-run transition magnitude is retained, while absolute total-variation scale is intentionally discarded. Define O_{sr} as the unique chronological noncrossing coupling returned by a cumulative-mass scan. Evaluate that fixed coupling by Cdir_{sr}, the transported mass joining opposite directions, and Ctime_{sr}, the transported normalized displacement |i/n_r-j/n_r|. Let T_s be the componentwise arithmetic mean of (Cdir_{sr},Ctime_{sr}) over the same common-informative runs for every candidate. Candidates are compared lexicographically by T_s: direction mismatch is the primary candidate-score coordinate and time displacement the secondary coordinate; direction is not separately optimized over arbitrary crossing couplings, and no scalar weight bridges the coordinates. Stable-sort candidates by ascending T_s, retaining baseline order on exact ties, then sort the current baseline likelihood-value multiset descending and assign those values in that candidate order before unchanged Bayesian accumulation and action scoring. This rank projection can change relative candidate evidence whenever the truth-blind order changes, but preserves the likelihood-value multiset exactly and uses no source truth or selected threshold. For the preregistered control, within each completed common-informative run cyclically shift each candidate's paired (v_{s,i},b_{s,i}) values by delta_r=floor(n_r/2) while retaining time coordinates and observation tokens, then recompute O_s, T_s, and the rank projection. The shift can change an order-sensitive score but need not do so for every nonconstant sequence; delta_r=0 runs and score-invariant shifted runs are marked non-informative/control failures rather than counted as confirmation. Source identities remain sequestered until baseline, aligned-transport, and shifted-control candidate orders have all been frozen.
applied_revisions.delta_summary: Repairs the T1/T2 contradiction between cumulative monotone scanning and arbitrary direction-first optimization, binds run aggregation and epsilon, handles zero mass before division, and states exactly what independent normalization retains.

applied_revisions.value:
1. Read the frozen M1/M2 source likelihood Lsrc_{s,t}, carrier likelihood Lcar_{s,t}, GADEN concentration y_t, timestamp, position, and existing causal run identifier for every candidate s on the realized prefix; lock and hash the likelihood-storage dtype and its machine epsilon, and output a schema-checked prefix table without source truth.
2. Within each run, let n_r be its edge count, compute adjacent Delta y_i and Delta g_{s,i}, and compute totals A_r=sum_i|Delta y_i| and B_{sr}=sum_i|Delta g_{s,i}| before any division. Mark the run common-informative only if A_r>0 and B_{sr}>0 for every candidate; exclude every other run for all candidates, and output identity if none remains.
3. On each common-informative run, construct ordered observation tokens (i/n_r,sign(Delta y_i),|Delta y_i|/A_r) and candidate field tokens (i/n_r,sign(Delta g_{s,i}),|Delta g_{s,i}|/B_{sr}), plus direction-mismatch and normalized time-displacement pair costs.
4. For every candidate and common-informative run, obtain the unique chronological noncrossing coupling O_{sr} by cumulative mass scanning and evaluate that fixed coupling as (Cdir_{sr},Ctime_{sr}); do not re-optimize direction mismatch over crossing couplings.
5. For every candidate, componentwise-average its per-run cost pairs over the identical common-informative run set to obtain T_s, then stable-sort candidates lexicographically by ascending T_s while preserving baseline order on exact ties; output the truth-blind candidate permutation.
6. Sort the current baseline likelihood values descending and assign them in the candidate order from step 5; output the exactly multiset-preserving M3 likelihood vector for the unchanged Bayesian accumulator and action selector.
7. In the offline gate only, cyclically shift each completed common-informative run's paired field (direction,mass) values by delta_r=floor(n_r/2) while retaining time coordinates, rerun steps 3-6, and output the shifted-pairing control vector; mark delta_r=0 or aligned/shifted score-invariant runs as non-informative control outcomes.
8. Freeze hashes of the baseline, aligned-transport, and shifted-control vectors for all fixed H02/H03 comparisons, then let the sequestered evaluator reveal source identities and compute the preregistered downstream ordering metric.
applied_revisions.delta_summary: Makes the T1 dataflow executable by moving zero guards before normalization, defining common support and aggregation, and making the operative S4 coupling reading explicit.

applied_revisions.value:
BLOCK 1 — PREMISES ledger:
P1. On the frozen realized path, the true candidate's source-over-carrier field transitions retain temporally ordered local agreement with GADEN concentration transitions even when absolute observed-to-modeled levels are not globally monotone — untested — falsification target.
P2. On a common-informative run set, transporting independently normalized transition mass by the unique chronological noncrossing coupling preserves relative within-run timing and magnitude shape that global concentration ranks discard; it intentionally discards absolute total-variation scale. Direction mismatch is the primary coordinate when comparing candidate scores and time displacement the secondary coordinate; direction is not optimized over arbitrary crossing couplings — untested — falsification target.
P3. The existing source/carrier likelihood pair is an internal contrast with stable semantics under frozen M1/M2; no source truth is needed to compute g_{s,t}.
OBSERVATION-MODEL premise. Samples come from an adaptively chosen, non-IID single-UAV path with intermittent censoring; the method conditions on the realized timestamps, positions, and causal run boundaries and does not assume that sampled edges are unbiased draws from a stationary plume.
ESTIMAND. At prefix k, T_s(k) is the componentwise mean, over the identical common-informative causally observed run prefixes, of the opposite-direction transported-mass fraction and normalized temporal displacement evaluated on the unique chronological noncrossing coupling between normalized observation-change mass and candidate-s normalized source-over-carrier-change mass. The offline evaluation estimand is the change in true-source pairwise ordering frequency over the fixed 106 H02/H03 comparisons after all truth-blind orders are frozen.
BLOCK 2 — NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT:
The naive runnable version pools all observed and modeled values and ranks a candidate by global rank agreement or one pooled correlation. Branch (i): it silently assumes samples are exchangeable under one stationary monotone relation, which is false in the target setting when intermittent regimes and adaptive motion change that relation; Causal Edge Transport confronts this by making ordered transition atoms and their chronological noncrossing coupling the scored object rather than adding cosmetics to a pooled statistic. STANDARD-TOOL FOLLOW-UP: monotone transport and sequence alignment are textbook tools, but this instance couples adaptively sampled observation edges to paired source-versus-carrier field edges, must preserve the incumbent likelihood multiset at the Bayesian interface, and must expose a pairing-breaking no-truth null; that constrained object and interface are the domain-specific contribution rather than an off-the-shelf distance. The design deliberately avoids the occupied ancestral routes of global empirical ranks, covariance whitening, Huber residual clipping, CUSUM segmentation, and ABC tolerance selection.
BLOCK 3 — DESIGN RATIONALE:
The anchor is kept as one deep gap because a separate correlation-regime or stationarity module is not required to run or falsify the ordering operator; the controlled diagnostic earns its seat only as the companion intervention on the same transport object. Windowed correlation, change-point segmentation, and learned calibration were rejected because they respectively regress to occupied covariance/CUSUM nodes or introduce tuning and access beyond the frozen fields. A likelihood-multiset interface is retained from the salvageable prior attempt, but the failed symmetric replication statistic and its invariant run permutation are replaced by a chronological pre-pairing construction and a null that can, but is not guaranteed to, alter its score; score invariance is reported as a control failure, not as confirming evidence.
applied_revisions.delta_summary: Repairs the T4 overclaims by aligning the premise and estimand with the fixed monotone coupling, relative-only magnitude, common support, and non-universal control response.

final_candidate.title: Causal Edge Transport Reorders Turbulent Plume Evidence Before Bayesian Search
final_candidate.hook: Exact horizon-2 lookahead can lose to myopic search when it plans through a misordered likelihood field; a smaller intervention is to replace global sample comparison with causal transport over the evidence already available. The proposal adds no planning depth, learned model, new House, or new seed.
final_candidate.hook_shape_rationale: Counter-intuitive minimalism: relative to exact horizon-2 information gain, the candidate is strictly no larger on planning depth and uses only frozen M1/M2 fields plus the realized observation prefix, while targeting the upstream source-order metric that the 22/106 result implicates. A structural-reframe hook was also viable because arxiv:2605.13208v1 globally ranks accumulated concentrations, but it was rejected because the user-supplied failed-lookahead contrast gives a sharper admission test than redescribing temporal exchangeability as tacit.

gap_closure.gap: At the frontier leaf represented by arxiv:2605.13208v1, no retrieved work establishes whether candidate-source ordering remains valid when a single-UAV trajectory samples a turbulent plume whose observed-to-modeled relation changes across intermittent regimes rather than remaining globally monotone — stakes: a source can be ranked below a geometrically incompatible rival before accumulation, wasting the fixed flight budget and making conclusions from monotone-sensor evaluations fail to transfer to held-out GADEN houses.
gap_closure.how_closed: The gap is closed by reframing candidate support as a lexicographic monotone-transport attribution over causal observation/field edges, then using a pre-cost temporal-pairing intervention—not a permutation of already-scored values—to supply the companion's confound-isolating offline gate.
